checkpoints.instruction: From exit 6, walk south along the tree-lined avenue.
Keep straight past the pharmacy; the hospital block is ahead on your right.
Cross at the footbridge, then follow the hospital fence.

conflictLandmarks.recoveryInstruction: The roundabout means you went one block too far. Turn around and return to the pharmacy corner.

checkpoints.instruction: At the campus corner, follow the blue outpatient signpost along the building.
The outpatient entrance is the door under the large sign, past the forecourt.

ambiguity.question: Do you see an outpatient sign above the door, or a red emergency sign?

conflictLandmarks.recoveryInstruction: That is the emergency entrance — you passed the outpatient door. Turn around and go back to the blue signpost.
